provenance: Area-to-area travel-time initial data bundled for the distribution, v1 (record CY, 2026-11-21). The set is exactly the initial values registered by migration 0020 (0020_register_area_travel_matrix_real_data): every entry was copied verbatim from one INSERT statement of that migration (park, area pair and its normalized keys, minutes at the 少しゆっくり 70 m/min baseline, source title, source URL, fetch date, and the migration's created/updated timestamps 1794495600000). A copy starts with exactly these rows registered (migration 0020 at build time, and migration 0050 as the seed migration in the same NOT EXISTS form as migrations 0035/0049; the seed in server/src/travel_time_seed.ts on reset). Rows accumulated at runtime in the production app beyond these 22 (30 rows in the saved production DB) are NOT bundled: they are runtime accumulation, not the defined initial values, exactly as the facility dictionary bundles its 75-entry seed rather than the production dictionary's accumulated rows. No value in this file comes from AI memory and no source was re-checked live for this bundling: fetchedAt / timestamps are migration 0020's own values, preserved as-is.

counts.note: Counts over the bundled initial set (the full migration 0020 registration).
